notes.title: Our demo is back!
notes.content:
Greetings game changers,

Before going on holidays, we wanted to thanks your warm support by giving you access to the latest version of our demo.

Among the major changes:
- Correction of the English text that was breaking the flow for native speakers.
- Automatic text option for those who want to sail with the narration.
- Major fix: We added an input delay at the beginning of each gameplay phase so you don't accidentally submit an answer. 

With this you'll find a lot of small improvement on the general experience. 

We'll be glad to hear what you think of it, or our general work so far. We added a new channel dedicated on Vulnerable on our discord server. Come say hi!

The Breakpoint Games team wishes you a merry Christmas, along with a warm and comforting end of year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1919960/Vulnerable/
